_note: Wave 0 baseline (docs/baseline_wave0.md). Corpus numbers are exact pins: a change in either direction fails the gate and must be an explicit edit of this file. Bench ceilings are max ns/op, each the larger of 2x the worst laptop run (5 engine, 2 HTTP) and 2x the worst run on the deploy/ec2 VM (m7i-flex.large, 5 engine, 3 HTTP); loose by design, they catch order-of-magnitude regressions only.
